title: Supervisor Coach: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Do not accept a disturbed joint back into service without its leak-test record.

items.text: Confirm the replacement seal matches the specification on the work order.
A repeat seal leak on the same pump is a signal to escalate to the maintenance manager, not a routine repair [FND-0002].

items.question: May a shift supervisor isolate the pump without waiting for approval?
items.why: The gas alarm only displayed and nobody was authorised to act [FND-0004].

items.text: Refuse to accept a pump whose seal has no specification reference.

Some regimes give workers and supervisors a right to stop work or to warn of imminent danger. The site should confirm which apply here, and how a supervisor who declines to accept work is supported [FND-0002].

sections.heading: Recommendations and how supervisors will know they are working
